A common correction preserves every quantile gap
Zero-initialized projection; no bias. Gate is bounded; correction amplitude is not.
Equivalent to adding the correction before inverse RevIN.
Training: mean pinball loss across seven quantiles; validation early stopping. No difference-loss term in this configuration.
Notation: BC = flattened batch × variables; N = 41 patches; M = 8 heads; K = 8 samples; head width = 8. Output is globally standardized until inverse data scaling.
